newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 12.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Taiwan to begin partial implementation of five-day work week in 1998.
Taiwan, China jostle over treatment of hijacker Liu Shn-chung.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Radiation leaks following fire on Japanese nuclear reprocessing plant
Transportation minister denies hijacked plane's route back to Taiwan marks direct flight.
LIBERTY TIMES - Vice President Lien Chan reiterates Taiwan does not rule out direct talks with communist China.
Mainland Affairs Council rules out exchanging hijackers with mainland.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Foreign funds inflow reaches US$1.3 billion for February.
Foreign banks rush to invest in mainland.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Foreign fund net inflow at US$781 million for 1997.
Mainland says negotiation with Taiwan on shipping links does not equal resumption of cross-strait semi-official talks.
